name: Pulse & Iron
description: High-energy, fully arranged pieces for training, running and movement: locked-in running cadences (160, 170 and 180 SPM), heavy lifting grooves, a true 8-round Tabata timer, cardio house, synthwave and a cool-down stretch that slows to a stop. Every piece has a beginning, middle and end and stops on its own.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Warm-Up Stride
sketches.description: Ease into motion at 118 BPM (about 1 min 38 s): a lone kick and opening chords in the intro, then the groove builds section by section with Dorian stabs that open up, a rising arpeggio and clap fills into every change.
sketches.source:
setcpm(118/4)
song("intro@4 groove@8 build@8 stride@16 stride'@8 outro@4", "once")

// Four-on-the-floor kick carries the whole warm-up
kick: s("bd*4").shape(.15).gain(bysec("intro:.55 outro:.6 *:.75"))

// Hats and claps join with the groove, with a clap fill at the end of each section
drums: stack(
  s("[~ oh]*4").gain(.3),
  s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.25).gain(.45).atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2)),
  s("hh*16").hpf(7000).gain("[.15 .3]*8")
).exceptSections("intro outro")

// Bouncy Dorian bassline, brightening as the warm-up progresses
bass: note("<[d2 ~ d2 a1 ~ d2 f2 g2] [c2 ~ c2 g1 ~ c2 e2 f2]>")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(bysec("groove:600 build:800 *:1000")).lpenv(2).lpdecay(.12)
  .decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.08).gain(.5)
  .exceptSections("intro")

// Warm chord stabs opening up through every section, one arc over the piece
chords: note("<[d3,f3,a3,c4] [g3,b3,d4,f4] [e3,g3,b3,d4] [a3,c4,e4,g4]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .lpf(env("900 2600", "section")).decay(.3).sustain(.2).release(.2)
  .room(.4).gain(env(".12 .26@4 .1", "song"))

// Bright rising arpeggio, doubling up for the final stride
arp: n("0 2 4 6 7 6 4 2").scale("D:dorian").transpose(12)
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.12).sustain(0)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).pan(sine.slow(4)).gain(.22)
  .sections("build stride").variant(x => x.ply(2))

sketches.name: Easy Jog (160 SPM)
sketches.description: A two-minute, steady 160 steps-per-minute cruising cadence: the quarter-note kick never drops out, so every beat matches a footstrike from first bar to last, while synthwave bass, arpeggio lifts and a horizon pad build and fade around it.
sketches.source:
setcpm(160/4)
song("intro@4 (cruise@16 lift@8)*2 cruise'@16 lift'@8 outro@4", "once")

// Every beat is a footstrike at 160 steps per minute, start to finish
kick: s("bd*4").shape(.2).gain(.8)

// Backbeat and off-beat hats join after the intro, with a snare fill into each section
drums: stack(
  s("~ sd ~ sd").room(.3).gain(.55).atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2)),
  s("[~ hh]*4").hpf(6000).gain(.35)
).exceptSections("intro")

// Driving eighth-note octave bass: Am, F, C, G
bass: note("<[a1 a2]*4 [f1 f2]*4 [c2 c3]*4 [g1 g2]*4>")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(env("700 1500", "section")).lpq(3)
  .decay(.12).sustain(.3).release(.05).gain(.48)
  .exceptSections("intro outro")

// Forward-moving arpeggio for the lifts, an octave higher on the last one
arp: n("0 2 4 7 4 2 0 4").add("<0 5 2 6>").scale("A:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.3).lpf(2400).decay(.1).sustain(0)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.2)
  .sections("lift").variant(x => x.transpose(12))

// Wide horizon pad arcing over the whole run
pad: note("<[a3,c4,e4] [f3,a3,c4] [c4,e4,g4] [g3,b3,d4]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.25)
  .attack(.3).release(1).lpf(1800).room(.6).gain(env(".1 .2@4 .1", "song"))

sketches.name: Tempo Run (170 SPM)
sketches.description: A 170 SPM tempo-run metronome disguised as melodic drum and bass (about 1 min 42 s): a click-kick on every step that never stops, rolling breaks with snare rolls into each drop, a reese bass, a breakdown and a final drop that answers the lead in G major.
sketches.source:
setcpm(170/4)
song("intro@8 roll@16 drop@16 break@8 drop'@16 outro@8", "once")

// A clear pulse on all four beats for 170 SPM, never dropping out
pulse: stack(
  s("bd*4").lpf(400).gain(.75),
  s("rim*4").hpf(1800).gain(.28)
)

// Fast break over the top, with a snare roll into each new section
drums: stack(
  s("~ sd ~ sd").room(.2).gain(.6).atEnd(1, x => x.ply(4)),
  s("hh*16").hpf(8000).gain("[.35 .15 .25 .15]*4")
).exceptSections("intro break outro")

// Warm reese bass propelling the low end, opening through each section
reese: note("<e1 c1 g1 d1>").s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.35)
  .lpf(env("300 900", "section")).lpq(3)
  .attack(.03).sustain(1).release(.2).gain(.4)
  .sections("roll drop")

// Uplifting chord progression: Em, C, G, D
pad: note("<[e3,g3,b3,d4] [c3,e3,g3,b3] [g3,b3,d4,f#4] [d3,f#3,a3,c#4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .attack(.2).release(.8).lpf(2000).room(.6).gain(env(".14 .22@4 .12", "song"))

// Sparkling lead motif in the drops, answered in G major on the last one
lead: n("<[4 ~ 6 ~ 7 ~ 9 ~] [7 ~ 6 ~ 4 ~ 2 ~]>")
  .scale(bysec("drop':G:major *:E:minor")).transpose(12)
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.2).sustain(0)
  .delay(.35).delaytime(3/16).room(.5).gain(.28)
  .sections("drop")

sketches.name: Race Pace (180 SPM)
sketches.description: Classic 180 steps-per-minute race cadence (96 s): a relentless footstrike kick from first beat to last, alternating push and anthem sections, an arpeggio that doubles to sixteenths in the final push and an anthem lead that lifts an octave for the finish.
sketches.source:
setcpm(180/4)
song("intro@4 (push@8 anthem@8)*3 push'@8 anthem'@8 outro@4", "once")

// 180 SPM: three steps every second, locked to the four-on-the-floor
kick: s("bd*4").shape(.25).gain(.82)

// Backbeat and hats, with a snare fill into every section
drums: stack(
  s("~ [sd,cp] ~ [sd,cp]").room(.2).gain(.6).atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2)),
  s("[~ oh]*4").gain(.32),
  s("hh*8").hpf(7500).gain(.25)
).exceptSections("intro outro")

// Galloping bass on Fm, Db, Ab, Eb
bass: note("<f1 db1 ab1 eb1>").ply(8)
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(1200).lpenv(1.5).lpdecay(.08)
  .decay(.1).sustain(.25).release(.04).gain(.48)
  .exceptSections("intro")

// High-energy arpeggiator, doubling to sixteenths in the final push
arp: n("[0 2 4 7]*2").add("<0 5 2 6>").scale("F:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.25).decay(.08).sustain(0)
  .delay(.25).delaytime(3/16).gain(.22)
  .sections("push").variant(x => x.ply(2))

// Anthem lead, an octave higher on the last chorus
lead: note("<[f4@3 g4 ab4@2 bb4 c5] [db5@3 c5 bb4@2 ab4 g4] [ab4@3 bb4 c5@2 db5 eb5] [c5@4 bb4@2 g4@2]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2).lpf(3200)
  .attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.6).release(.15)
  .room(.4).gain(.26)
  .sections("anthem").variant(x => x.transpose(12))

sketches.name: Tabata HIIT (20s On / 10s Off)
sketches.description: A true Tabata interval timer at 120 BPM (2 s per bar, 4 min 16 s in total): a short ready count, then eight rounds of 10 bars (20 s) of high-intensity work and 5 bars (10 s) of recovery breathing, each work round opened by a triple boxing bell, then a final bell.
sketches.source:
setcpm(120/4)
// 2 s per bar: 10 bars = 20 s WORK, 5 bars = 10 s REST, eight rounds
song("ready@4 (work@10 rest@5)*8 done@4", "once")

// Get-ready count-in that swells toward the first bell
count: s("rim*4").hpf(1500).gain(env(".15 .5", "section")).sections("ready")

// Boxing bell: triple ring to start every work round
bell: note("[c5*3 ~ ~ ~]").once().sections("work")
  .s("sine").fm(3.5).fmh(2.41).decay(.8).sustain(0).release(.8)
  .room(.4).gain(.5)

// A single low bell to start every rest and to end the session
restbell: note("[c4 ~ ~ ~]").once().sections("rest done")
  .s("sine").fm(3.5).fmh(2.41).decay(.8).sustain(0).release(.8)
  .room(.4).gain(.5)

// WORK: relentless kick, clap and driving acid bass, doubling up for the last 2 s
drums: s("bd*4, ~ cp ~ cp, [~ oh]*4, hh*16").shape(.2).gain(.8)
  .sections("work").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
bass: note("c2 c2 eb2 c2 g1 bb1 c2 d2")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(env("600 2400", "section")).lpq(6).lpenv(2).lpdecay(.1)
  .decay(.12).sustain(.2).release(.05).gain(.5)
  .sections("work")
stabs: note("[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]").struct("x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.25).lpf(2200).decay(.15).sustain(0).gain(.28)
  .sections("work")

// REST: a calm pad and a steady heartbeat pulse while you catch your breath
recover: note("[c3,g3,eb4]")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(.5).release(1.5).room(.7).gain(.25)
  .sections("ready rest done")
heart: s("bd ~ ~ ~").lpf(180).gain(.4).sections("rest done")

sketches.name: Iron Temple
sketches.description: Heavy half-time lifting music at 140 BPM (about 1 min 57 s): a tense bell intro, three verse-and-drop sets with aggressive brass stabs, a distorted 808 sub, snapping snares and triplet hat rolls into each drop, a bridge and a brighter final drop.
sketches.source:
setcpm(140/4)
song("intro@4 (verse@8 drop@8)*3 bridge@4 drop'@8 outro@4", "once")

// Half-time stadium beat: huge snare on beat 3, triplet hat roll into each section
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").shape(.3).gain(.85),
  s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [sd,cp] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").room(.35).gain(.75),
  s("hh*8").sometimesBy(.4, x => x.ply("<2 3 4>")).hpf(6500).gain(.35)
    .atEnd(1, x => x.ply(3))
).exceptSections("intro bridge")

// Heavy 808 sub with grit and glide
sub: note("<[d1@6 d1 ~ f1@4 a1@4] [bb0@6 bb0 ~ a0@4 c1@4]>")
  .s("sine").mono(1).glide(.06).shape(.35)
  .attack(.005).decay(1.2).sustain(.5).release(.15).gain(.6)
  .exceptSections("intro outro")

// Menacing low brass hits in the drops and bridge, opening up on the final drop
brass: note("<[[d2,a2,d3,f3]@3 ~ [d2,a2,d3,f3] ~@3] [[bb1,f2,bb2,d3]@3 ~ [a1,e2,a2,c#3]@4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3)
  .lpf(1100).lpenv(2.5).lpattack(.02).lpdecay(.25)
  .attack(.02).decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.2).room(.4).gain(.36)
  .sections("drop bridge").variant(x => x.lpf(2200))

// High tension bell ostinato framing the verses
bell: note("d4 a4 bb4 a4 f4 a4 d4 e4")
  .s("sine").fm(2.5).fmh(3).decay(.2).sustain(0)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.2)
  .sections("intro verse bridge outro")

sketches.name: Cardio Engine
sketches.description: Peak-hour tech-house at 128 BPM (2 min 30 s): a rolling sub-bass groove, a synth hook whose filter builds through every section, crisp claps with fills, a kick-free breakdown and two drops with vocal chops for bikes, rowers and circuits.
sketches.source:
setcpm(128/4)
song("intro@8 groove@16 build@8 drop@16 break@8 drop'@16 outro@8", "once")

// Punchy club kick, out only for the breakdown
kick: s("bd*4").shape(.2).gain(.82).exceptSections("break")

// Club kit with a clap fill at the end of each section
drums: stack(
  s("[~ oh]*4").gain(.35),
  s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.2).gain(.55).atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2)),
  s("hh*16").hpf(8000).gain(saw.range(.12, .32).fast(4)),
  s("~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~").pan(.35).gain(.3)
).exceptSections("intro break")

// Rolling off-beat tech-house bassline
bass: note("~ g1 g1 ~ g1 ~ bb1 c2 ~ g1 g1 ~ f1 ~ eb1 f1")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(550).lpq(4).lpenv(2).lpdecay(.1)
  .decay(.15).sustain(.2).release(.05).shape(.15).gain(.55)
  .exceptSections("break")

// Hypnotic synth hook: the filter builds through each section and resets on the change
hook: note("[g3 bb3 d4 g3 eb4 d4 bb3 g3]*2")
  .s("square").pw(.2).unison(2).detune(.15)
  .lpf(env("500 3200", "section")).lpq(5)
  .decay(.1).sustain(0).delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.22)
  .exceptSections("intro outro")

// Vocal chop accent on the turnaround, only in the drops
vox: note("<~ [~ d4 ~ f4 ~ g4 ~ ~]>").s("aah")
  .attack(.01).decay(.15).sustain(0).release(.1)
  .delay(.35).delaytime(3/8).room(.4).gain(.3)
  .sections("drop")

sketches.name: Cyber Sprint
sketches.description: Dark outrun synthwave at 134 BPM (about 1 min 40 s): a pad-and-bass intro, relentless sixteenth-note bass, gated snares and a heroic minor-key lead in two chase sections, soaring an octave higher in the final push.
sketches.source:
setcpm(134/4)
song("intro@4 drive@8 chase@16 drive'@8 chase'@16 outro@4", "once")

// Punchy 80s drums with big gated reverb on the snare
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").shape(.25).gain(.82),
  s("~ [sd,cp] ~ [sd,cp]").room(.65).size(.8).gain(.6),
  s("hh*16").hpf(7000).gain("[.3 .15]*8"),
  s("<~ ~ ~ [lt*2 mt*2 ht*4]>").room(.5).gain(.5)
).exceptSections("intro")

// Relentless sixteenth-note bass: Cm, Ab, Fm, G, opening through each section
bass: note("<c1 ab0 f1 g1>").ply(16)
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(env("500 1400", "section")).lpq(4).lpenv(1.8).lpdecay(.07)
  .decay(.09).sustain(.15).release(.03).gain(.48)
  .exceptSections("outro")

// Heroic synth lead, an octave higher in the final chase
lead: note("<[c4@2 d4 eb4 g4@3 f4] [eb4@2 d4 c4 bb3@4] [ab3@2 bb3 c4 f4@3 eb4] [d4@4 g4@4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2).mono(1).glide(.04)
  .lpf(3000).vib(5).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.01).decay(.3).sustain(.6).release(.15)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.28)
  .sections("chase").variant(x => x.transpose(12))

// Shimmering chord bed, one arc over the whole piece
pad: note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3] [f2,ab2,c3] [g2,b2,d3]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3).lpf(1600)
  .attack(.2).release(.8).room(.6).gain(env(".22 .18@4 .12", "song"))

sketches.name: Boxer's Jump Rope
sketches.description: High-stepping 112 BPM funk (about 1 min 34 s): a skip-rope hi-hat intro, then rounds of tight clavinet and slapping bass with first and second endings (a horn combo, then a drill), a last round and combo, and a horn outro for footwork, shadowboxing and agility drills.
sketches.source:
setcpm(112/4)
song("intro@4 (round@8 1.combo@4 2.drill@4)*2 round'@8 combo'@4 outro@4", "once")

// Skip-rope sixteenth-note hat from first bar to last
rope: s("hh*16").hpf(7500).swing(3).gain("[.35 .15 .25 .15]*4")

// Tight breakbeat with a snare fill into each section
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").shape(.15).gain(.8),
  s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd?0.3 ~ sd?0.2 ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").gain(.65).atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
).exceptSections("intro")

// Bouncy slap-style bass
bass: note("e1 ~ e2 ~ g1 a1 b1 ~ e1 ~ d2 ~ b1 a1 g1 ~").swing(3)
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(950).lpenv(2.5).lpdecay(.08)
  .decay(.14).sustain(.2).release(.05).gain(.55)
  .exceptSections("intro")

// Percussive clavinet comping
clav: note("~ [e3,g3,b3] ~ [e3,g3,b3] [f#3,a3,c#4] ~ ~ [e3,g3,b3] ~ [e3,g3,b3] ~ [f#3,a3,c#4] ~ ~ [g3,b3,d4] ~").swing(3)
  .s("square").pw(.2).lpf(2600).lpq(5)
  .attack(.002).decay(.09).sustain(0).pan(.35).gain(.22)
  .exceptSections("intro outro")

// Brass section punches on the combos, drill and outro, doubled on the last combo
horns: note("<[~ ~ ~ [b4,d5,g5] ~ [a4,c#5,f#5] ~ ~] [~ ~ ~ [g4,b4,e5]@2 ~ ~ ~]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.15)
  .lpf(1800).lpenv(2).lpattack(.02).lpdecay(.15)
  .attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.1).pan(.65).room(.3).gain(.3)
  .sections("combo drill outro").variant(x => x.ply(2))

sketches.name: Cool-Down Stretch
sketches.description: Bring the heart rate back down over about four minutes: the tempo eases from 72 to 64 BPM and slows to 52 BPM at the end. A gentle halftime pulse fades out under warm Rhodes chords and a deep sub, a chime marks every four-bar stretch change, and a four-bar breathing guide leads into the final rest.
sketches.source:
setcpm(64/4)
song("settle@8 stretch@16 stretch'@16 breathe@16 rest@8", "once")
// Ease from 72 to 64 BPM, hold, then a ritardando to 52 BPM over the final rest
tempomap("0:18 8:16 56:16 64:13")

// Soft halftime pulse to ease the heart rate down, gone by the breathing section
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").lpf(220).gain(.45),
  s("~ ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~").room(.5).gain(.2),
  s("hh*8").hpf(7000).gain(.08)
).exceptSections("breathe rest")

// Warm Rhodes chords: Ebmaj7, Cm9, Abmaj7, Bb6, an octave up for the second stretch
keys: note("<[eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [c3,eb3,g3,d4] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,g3]>")
  .s("sine").fm(.9).fmh(2).trem(3).tremdepth(.2)
  .attack(.05).decay(1.5).sustain(.3).release(1.5)
  .lpf(1800).room(.7).size(.85).gain(env(".3 .28@4 .12", "song"))
  .variant(x => x.transpose(12))

// Deep, calm root bass
bass: note("<eb2 c2 ab1 bb1>").s("sine")
  .attack(.2).decay(1).sustain(.5).release(1).gain(.35)
  .exceptSections("rest")

// A gentle chime marks every four-bar stretch change
chime: note("<bb4 ~ ~ ~>").s("sine").fm(2).fmh(3.5)
  .decay(3).sustain(0).release(3).room(.8).gain(.16)

// Breathing guide: swell in for two bars, out for two
breath: note("eb4").s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(1.5).release(2).room(.8).gain(env("0 .18 0", 4))
  .sections("breathe rest")
